{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the revenue column for formatting
print("First 5 values of revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check for thousands separators
print("\nUnique revenue values with commas:")
print(df['revenue'].unique())

# Check if any values contain commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"\nNumber of rows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}")"}
